publication_text: DXC Investor Day 2026 Transcript, June 11, 2026, PDF pp. 15, 59–60, and 68–69. Official transcript. Commercial paths are management statements; four or five people is an example. This does not establish realized sales, gross margin, or renewal outcomes.

Uvik, “Forward Deployed Engineering,” official service description, checked September 17, 2026. Covers team management, billing and contract arrangements, office locations, and time zones. This is a provider's public service description, not a signed contract or client outcome record.

Optywise, FDE service description and company introduction, checked September 17, 2026. Used to check managed engineering pods, the six-week cycle, the Pune address, and North American market positioning. Six weeks is a service commitment; actual duration, profit, and client acceptance records were not obtained.

Turing, “Enterprise AI,” official service description, checked September 17, 2026. Describes the combined positioning of FDEs and Turing Intelligence Platform. The page does not disclose separate platform and service charges or profit. Promotional outcome figures are not used to establish clients' business outcomes.

DXC, Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, Note 16, printed pp. 23–25, and MD&A p. 31. SEC original. Used to check the segment profit definition, reconciliation, and gap in product disclosure. Company or segment figures are not used to infer product profit.
